questions_for_mark.question: How do this plan and M4.3b fit: (A) absorb M4.3b's 3D half (U2), loop re-pointed via charter; (B) framework only, loop builds the cards; (C) loop builds M4.3b in today's HUD, migrate later; under every option the M4.3b 'shortcuts M, L and K' and M4.5 'bot through Godot's input layer' rows are amended in the same attended charter edit before the loop starts either
M stays an instant read-only star chart (no commit, no pause); plotting and commit only at the navigation station
Pacing controls (tour pause, skip dwell, skip stage K, Sgr A* finish approach K, warp level) instant or console (edge: time warp is pacing but has no 3D-ship control; cruise speed is a helm decision)
Console presentation: camera dolly and framed panel vs fully in-world interactive screens
Layout: navigation station for all where-the-ship-goes decisions, Voyage console for the guided voyage, Archive terminal, decision_1..3 reserved for M6
Accessibility: press-twice confirm setting, click-to-walk, keyboard Walk-to list

coordination.M4.3b: see Q1; under A, M4.3b's 3D-ship deliverable is U2 and M4.5's scene half starts after U6 using ShipConsoles.use

AC2: make ship-ui-test && make lint-precision; one_minus_beta asserted present in every phase; grep -n '1.0 - beta' demos/ship_geometry_demo.gd ui/ship_hud.gd tests/fixtures/lint_precision/allowlist.txt is empty
features.notes: ui/ship_hud.gd ShipHud: two-row status strip (clocks same size CLOCK_SIZE 17, speed while moving, view tag click-to-toggle; where and distance second row, width capped clear of the corner), card stack (priority, MAX_EXPANDED 2, fades 0.4/0.6 s, column width min(280, w/3 - 24) so it stays right of the centre third), prompt line, onboarding hint slot, Tab panel (Walk to, display, journey rows, details, grouped help, dev box). hud_text() and the button column retired; dev controls (B, G, 5, 6, audit) gated on menu_return. 1.0 - beta fallback and its allowlist row removed; speed digits from ship.beta. make ship-ui-test: 149 checks green.

features.description: Contextual cards (M4.3b's 3D-ship half under Q1(A)): transit (JourneyHud.ROWS compact, full in Tab), brake and final-approach notices, arrival, gravity (BlackHoleVisit.hud_lines), tour card with pacing buttons (P pause, N skip dwell, K skip stage; warp level shown only, no new warp control), Archive unlock, refusal; dwell label on stars and bodies (read-only identification pick).
acceptance_criteria: AC3: make ship-ui-test (one case per card row: appear trigger, leave trigger, priority, no overlap of the centre third at 1280x720 and 2560x1440)
features.notes: Cards: transit (JourneyHud.ROWS compact 7 rows; warp = live pacing rate, sci format), brake/final-approach notices 8 s, arrival (ArrivalCard.ROWS; Enter/Esc/Dismiss or next commit), gravity (BlackHoleVisit.hud_lines as bindings), tour (leg, stage, dwell left, PAUSED; Pause [P], Skip dwell, Skip stage [K]), interlude chip (D-41 InterludeCard unchanged in content, placed left of the column), unlock (codex toast moved into the stack, 10 s; baseline per sim session), refusal 8 s. Dwell label: deferred to PR 2 with the consoles (needs the reach/facing raycast work); the I card is unchanged. Renders renders/ship_ui/{strip_rest,transit_cruise,arrival,tour_interlude,sgr_a_gravity,lower_deck}_{1280x720,2560x1440}.png opened: strip legible over the bright Auto cruise sky; cards clear of the centre; found and fixed: strip overflow at cruise (now two rows), duplicate from-Earth, codex toasts still drawing, unlock baseline a frame late, interlude card colliding with the column.

features.description: demos/ship_consoles.gd (ShipConsoles): stations from ship.glb node names (console_navigation_0..2, console_decision_0..3, archive_terminal); use points via WalkArea.closest_walkable(origin, 2.5) with walked path lengths printed (40 m ceiling); E priority = nearest interactable in reach and facing, lift included, named by the prompt; reach (2.5 m) and facing (60 deg) prompt; E or click to use; 0.6 s camera dolly focus and back; panel host aligned to the console rect; click-to-walk and Tab Walk-to (WalkArea.path, 3.5 m/s, WASD cancels); confirm modes hold 1.5 s / press twice (setting in ui/game_settings.gd); idle screens (display only); onboarding glow and hint; use(station, action) as the single decision entry.
acceptance_criteria: AC6: make ship-console-test (hold and press-twice confirms; release restarts with no penalty; intent payload independent of delay)
AC8: make ship-console-test (all stations load; every active station has a non-empty WalkArea.path from the bridge spawn; prompt only in reach and facing)
AC14a: make ship-console-test (keyboard Walk-to list reaches every station; lower-deck prompt names the lift)
